description:
List all soul inscriptions (text/markdown) owned by a Taproot address.

Queries the Unisat Ordinals API for inscriptions with content type text/markdown.
If no address is provided, uses the current wallet's Taproot address.

Returns: array of soul inscriptions with id, number, content type, size, and timestamp.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Taproot (bc1p...) address to query. Omit to use the current wallet's Taproot address.

name: souldinals_list_souls
